caption: The drawing depicts a detailed geometric border and central design rendered on a rectangular surface. The composition consists of multiple parallel decorative bands running along the left and bottom sides, suggesting the corner of a larger pattern. The principal colors used are earthy tones: a reddish-brown, muted green, and dark beige. The innermost band features a large interlaced pattern forming looping knots containing small four-petal motifs inside diamond-shaped frames, alternating with simpler four-petal designs outside the main loops. This is bordered by a repetitive grid of diamonds, each containing a small central dot or solid square, which is itself bordered by a narrow green band and a zigzagged reddish border. Additional bands display intricate crosshatching and checkered patterns, interspersed by narrow green and beige linear borders. The outermost band is a solid reddish-brown. The overall design gives a sense of layering and contains no figures or naturalistic elements, focusing entirely on abstract and geometric motifs. The bottom right corner bears a small signature in black ink.
title: Leather Seat in Confessional (Detail)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
